role.roleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Wealth Services Platform

evidence.text: Maintained the evaluation harness (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner) and the labelled review set of adviser-confirmed alerts, adding 1,200 newly labelled alerts over the year.
Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the four model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report to the model team and adviser operations.

The false-alert rate seen by advisers fell from 31 percent in Q1 to 18 percent in Q4 after the threshold recalibration I proposed was adopted in version 3.2, as measured on the labelled review set and reported against the documented Q1 baseline of 31 percent.
Coordinated release decisions in the model release meeting; the model team lead took the go/no-go decision and adviser operations confirmed the alert-volume impact.

Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing the review-set composition, the known limitation that alerts on newly onboarded portfolios were under-represented, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.
